args.script:
cat << 'EOF' > calculate_line_count.sh
#!/bin/bash

# Calculate the total line count of all .txt files in 'experiment' directory
# that contain at least one occurrence of the keyword "keyword"

KEYWORD="keyword"
TOTAL_LINES=0

# Find all .txt files in experiment directory (including subdirectories)
while IFS= read -r -d '' file; do
    # Check if the file contains the keyword (case-insensitive)
    if grep -qi "$KEYWORD" "$file"; then
        # Count lines in files that contain the keyword
        LINE_COUNT=$(wc -l < "$file")
        TOTAL_LINES=$((TOTAL_LINES + LINE_COUNT))
        echo "File: $file - Contains keyword, lines: $LINE_COUNT"
    else
        echo "File: $file - Does NOT contain keyword, skipped"
    fi
done < <(find experiment -name "*.txt" -type f -print0)

echo ""
echo "Total line count of .txt files containing keyword '$KEYWORD': $TOTAL_LINES"
EOF
chmod +x calculate_line_count.sh
